title: Garments and Robes
summary: Garments could signal ordinary dress, status, mourning, priestly service, or symbolic identity.
background: Robes, torn garments, special garments, and white garments all carry meaning in different contexts. Clothing can signal honor, shame, grief, or righteousness.
teachingHelp: When clothing details appear, ask what status, response, or spiritual truth the text is emphasizing.
